ipa.surfaces.cap.SurfaceLayout

This class property contains the properties that may be used to control how the surface is displayed.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.cap.SurfaceLayout.

Syntax

SurfaceLayout(
    *,
    data_points: Iterable[VolatilitySurfacePoint] = None,
    format: Format = None,
    x_values: list[str] | None = None,
    y_values: list[str] | None = None,
    z_values: list[str] | None = None,
    x_point_count: int | None = None,
    y_point_count: int | None = None,
    z_point_count: int | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
data_points Iterable[VolatilitySurfacePoint] No None Specifies the list of specific data points to be returned
format Format No None Specifies whether the calculated volatilities are returned as a list or a matrix
x_values list[str] | None No None Specifies a list of discrete values for the x-axis
y_values list[str] | None No None Specifies a list of discrete values for the y-axis
z_values list[str] | None No None Specifies a list of discrete values for the z-axis
x_point_count int | None No None Specifies the number of values that will be generated along the x-axis. These values will distributed depending on the available input data and the type of volatility
y_point_count int | None No None Specifies the number of values that will be generated along the y-axis. These values will distributed depending on the available input data and the type of volatility
z_point_count int | None No None Specifies the number of values that will be generated along the z-axis. These values will distributed depending on the available input data and the type of volatility

Example

from lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.fx import SurfaceLayout
from lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces import fx
SurfaceLayout(format=fx.Format.MATRIX)

Related types

The enumerate that specifies whether the calculated volatilities
